_comment: Copy truth gate. forbidden = claims that are false today (any occurrence, any locale). required = the honest wording that must be visible in that locale. Update this file whenever the copy intentionally changes; a failing gate is the reminder, not the enemy. requiredBundle = strings that must exist in the served JS (used for copy behind login, which the DOM pass cannot reach). forbidden entries are regular expressions.

required.phrase: only your account can use it
nur dein Konto kann ihn nutzen

requiredBundle: unless you choose a server or cloud channel
除非你主动选择服务端或云端通道
nur hochgeladen, wenn du einen Server- oder Cloud-Kanal
